rows.question: Has the company entered into a cooperation, nomination, or standstill agreement with an activist or other significant shareholder? If so, summarize the key terms.
rows.answer: Yes. On October 15, 2025, BILL Holdings entered into a Cooperation Agreement with Starboard Value LP and affiliated entities after Starboard notified the company on September 5, 2025 of its intent to nominate four director candidates. Under the agreement, Starboard withdrew its nomination notice; the Board confirmed the resignation of director Stephen Fisher, expanded the Board from 12 to 13 seats and appointed Peter A. Feld and Lee Kirkpatrick as Class II directors; the company agreed to nominate Natalie Derse, David Hornik, Katherine (Allie) Kline and Beth Johnson as Class III directors at the 2025 Annual Meeting; Starboard agreed to vote its shares in accordance with Board recommendations at that meeting (subject to limited exceptions); the Board size cannot be increased above 13 without Starboard's consent until a specified date tied to the 2026 nomination deadline or the first anniversary of the Annual Meeting; Feld must resign if Starboard's ownership falls below a minimum threshold; the agreement includes non-disparagement and confidentiality obligations; and BILL agreed to reimburse Starboard up to $575,000 for its documented expenses related to its involvement with BILL, including its Schedule 13D filings and nomination/proxy preparation.
rows.period: as of October 15, 2025 (disclosed in DEF 14A filed 2025-10-27, covering FY2026 proxy)

citations.quote: on October 15, 2025, we entered into a cooperation agreement (the Cooperation Agreement) with Starboard Value LP and Starboard Value and Opportunity Master Fund Ltd and certain of their affiliates (collectively, Starboard), in which, among other things, (i) we confirmed the resignation of Stephen Fisher as a Class II director, (ii) we increased the size of the Board from 12 to 13 directors and appointed Peter A. Feld and Lee Kirkpatrick as Class II directors, (iii) we agreed that Natalie Derse, David Hornik, Katherine (Allie) Kline and Beth Johnson would be nominated for election as Class III directors at the Annual Meeting and (iv) Starboard agreed to vote all shares of our common stock beneficially owned by it in accordance with the Board’s recommendations at the Annual Meeting, subject to certain limited exceptions.
